d.seg: நான் உங்களுக்கு நான் எப்படி கால் பண்ணனும் என்ன எல்லாமே டீடைலா வாட்ஸ்அப்ல சொல்றேன் உங்களுக்கு நானு
d.tr: I will tell you in detail on WhatsApp how I should call you and everything
d.ctx: The expert offers to share details on WhatsApp on how to call her. The user agrees.
d.j: The expert is proposing to move the conversation to WhatsApp to share contact details.

d.seg: இல்ல நம்பர் வேண்டாம் நான் டெலிகிராம் ஐடி வேணா தரேன்
d.tr: No, I don't want the number, I can give you my Telegram ID
d.ctx: The user refuses to share a phone number but offers a Telegram ID instead.
d.j: The user is proposing to move the conversation to Telegram by offering an ID.

d.seg: எல்லாமே வாட்ஸ்அப் டெலிகிராம் எல்லாம் யூஸ் பண்ணுவாங்க
d.ctx: The expert mentions that everyone uses WhatsApp and Telegram.
d.j: The expert is mentioning external apps in a general context, not proposing to use them for contact.

d.seg: ஆனா என்னால பேச முடியாது உங்களுக்கு ஓகேவா
d.tr: But I cannot talk, is it okay for you?
d.ctx: The user says they cannot talk and asks if it is okay.
d.j: The user is setting up a communication method outside the app, which is a platform move.

d.ctx: The user provides their phone number.
d.j: The user is sharing their phone number, which is a direct platform move.
